استلفوا (form VIII)

# اُسْتُلِفُوا (ustulifū) /us.tu.li.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
# اِسْتَلِفُوا (istalifū) /is.ta.li.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
